The only note here is classed alternative_rendering ('Or, tumors. Or, plague boils'), which concerns English wording and never decides a reading. No italicized supply bears on the choice. Underdetermined; the qere base fallback carries the projection.

variant_decisions.evidence: ASV reads 'another man shall lie with her'. 'Lie with' is the plain lexical rendering of the qere ישכבנה (שכב, to lie down with); the ketiv ישגלנה (שגל) means to ravish or violate, which the ASV does not say, here or in a note. The two readings differ in English-visible force, not merely in spelling, and the ASV wording matches the qere, so the ASV distinguishes this reading. No mapped textual_variant note qualifies it.
